# Crystal Sterl Partners

Crystal Sterl Partners is a leading Nigerian law firm with a distinctly global outlook. The firm delivers corporate, transactional, dispute resolution, and full-service legal advisory to businesses, investors, institutions, and high-net-worth individuals across Africa and internationally.

## Contact

- Website: https://crystalsterl.com
- Email: info@crystalsterl.com

- Location: Nigeria (advising clients across Africa and internationally)

## Practice Areas

1. **Corporate Securities, Finance & Funds** — Capital markets, securities regulation, structured finance, fund formation, and M&A. https://crystalsterl.com/expertise/corporate-securities-finance-funds/
2. **Energy, Oil, Gas & Natural Resources** — Upstream, midstream and downstream energy transactions, NUPRC and NMDPRA regulatory compliance, and project finance. https://crystalsterl.com/expertise/energy-oil-gas-natural-resources/
3. **Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance** — Board advisory, FCCPC and CBN compliance, corporate restructuring, and regulatory strategy. https://crystalsterl.com/expertise/corporate-governance-regulatory-compliance/
4. **Intellectual Property, Data & Privacy** — Trade marks, patents, copyright, NDPR (Nigeria Data Protection Regulation) and GDPR compliance. https://crystalsterl.com/expertise/intellectual-property-data-protection/
5. **Litigation, Arbitration & ADR** — Commercial litigation, international arbitration (ICC, LCIA, ICSID), and alternative dispute resolution. https://crystalsterl.com/expertise/litigation-arbitration-adr/
6. **Tax, Real Estate, Privatisation & Procurement** — FIRS advisory, real estate transactions, REITs, public-private partnerships (PPP), and BPP procurement compliance. https://crystalsterl.com/expertise/tax-real-estate-privatisation-procurement/
7. **Technology, Media & Telecommunications** — NCC and NBC regulatory matters, fintech law, data governance, and digital media. https://crystalsterl.com/expertise/technology-media-telecommunication/

Financial Services, Energy & Infrastructure, Insurance & Pensions, Technology & AI, Healthcare, Real Estate, Consumer & Retail, Agriculture, Transportation, Sport & Entertainment, Public Sector & Development Finance, Private Wealth & Family Office.

## About the Firm

Crystal Sterl Partners operates on the values of Excellence, Clarity, Precision, and Execution. The firm takes a cross-practice approach, bringing together lawyers from multiple disciplines to deliver integrated legal solutions on complex matters. The firm is committed to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles and advises clients on embedding responsible practices into their operations.

Crystal Sterl Partners advises on cross-border transactions, international arbitration, foreign direct investment, and multi-jurisdictional regulatory matters — making it a trusted partner for Nigerian and international businesses operating across Africa.
